_doc: DRAFT terms: proposed by an agent for works that have no term yet, waiting for acceptance. A timeline form may name one; saving that form on /artifact-timeline moves the draft (and every draft it is built from) into commons/modular/terms.json (tools/artifact_timeline.py promote_drafts). Same shape as a terms.json term, plus drafted_by / drafted_for.

chair_pyramid.expr: step(array(chair, 3 x 3) + array(chair, 2 x 2) + chair * 2 + chair, physics) = chair_pyramid - sixteen chairs stacked 9 + 4 + 2 + 1; gravity decides what falls

thrown_die.expr: step(dice, physics) = thrown_die - the die leaves the hand; the settled face is read, not generated

random_step_walk.expr: trail(random(point, step)) = random_step_walk - each position is the last one plus a draw; the trail is what is kept

sampled_histogram.expr: sort(sample(array(box, 16)), by bin) = sampled_histogram — draws binned: the bars are a record of a sample, not the law itself

min_distance_sample.expr: decide(random(array(point, 30)), no nearer than d to any kept point) = min_distance_sample — dart throwing: a candidate is refused when it lands too close; spacing is a rule of admission

build.rule: refuse within d of an admitted point

lcg_register_film.expr: exhibit(lcg_step + array(bit, 64) + array(bar, 16)) = lcg_register_film - a screen films the crank's own arithmetic: sixteen outputs replayed from one seed

random_digit_page.expr: hand(drive(random(array(number, 10 x 28)), cascade), freeze) = random_digit_page - a table of drawn digits flows; a touch keeps one

lcg_step.expr: hand(rule(array(lamp, 32), x' = (a*x + c) mod m)) + array(box, 8, counts) = lcg_step - the next number is computed from the last one: the same seed gives the same sequence

seed_replay.expr: hand(random(array(box, 8), seed s) * 2 + random(array(box, 8), seed s + 1)) = seed_replay - the same seed repaints the same grid; one more and it is another grid

random_abacus.expr: trail(hand(array(random(line + bead, target x), 5))) = random_abacus - five beads sent to drawn positions at four speeds; the wall keeps where each has been

one_number_four_uses.expr: random(seed 435) -> transform(point, at) + transform(point, scale) + transform(cube, rot) + config(point, hue) = one_number_four_uses - one drawn value, four consequences

slot_machine.expr: hand(random(cylinder * 3) + array(box, 6, counts), lever) = slot_machine - three independent draws stop one by one; the counts flatten as you keep pulling

frame_interval_trace.expr: trail(array(point, 240, measured frame intervals)) = frame_interval_trace - the clock's own jitter, recorded: what the seed witness hashes

random_return.expr: drive(random(grab_sphere + arrow * 2 + ring of 24 points, angle and radius), out and back) = random_return - one drawn destination per excursion; the return is authored

interval_bits.expr: decide(random(array(point, 96), exponential gaps), t1 < t2) + array(box, 24) = interval_bits - bits taken from which of two waits was longer

lava_hash_wall.expr: rule(field(drive(array(ball * 4, 6 x 2)), sampled image 96 x 48), hash) + array(box, 48) = lava_hash_wall - moving blobs are photographed and hashed into 48 values

chair.expr: association(leg * 4 + seat + back + collider + grabbable) = chair - an ordinary thing that can be counted, coloured and moved

chair_colour_shares.expr: array(random(array(chair, 8, palette shares), draw one), 4) = chair_colour_shares - Shannon: which colour comes next, at 4:4, 7:1 and 8:0

chair_arrangements.expr: array(config(array(chair, 8), brief), 3) = chair_arrangements - Boltzmann: how many arrangements fit one description, 1 or 36

cooling_cup_series.expr: drive(array(association(cylinder, cup of coffee), 5, times 0-60 s), clock) = cooling_cup_series - thermodynamic entropy: the same cup at five moments of cooling and mixing

chair_scatter_recipe.expr: random(array(chair, 8), seed 435: scatter) = chair_scatter_recipe - algorithmic complexity: a scatter with a short recipe, the seed

frosted_chair_series.expr: array(chair + association(pane, frosted glass), 5, palette alpha) = frosted_chair_series - conditional entropy: what remains to guess once the glass hides detail

door_map_pair.expr: hand(rule(door * 2, x/2) + rule(door * 2, 2x mod 1), step) = door_map_pair - two starts under two rules: one pair closes together, the other separates

one_guess_piles.expr: random(chair_pyramid * 4, palettes 8/8, 8/4/4, 12/4, 16/0: draw one) = one_guess_piles - min-entropy: the best single guess, whatever the pile looks like

ruin.expr: step(hand(drum * 8 * 4 + array(brick, 12 x 6), pull one), physics) = ruin - one support is drawn out; contact and gravity decide what still holds

hand_decay.expr: hand(association(cube + sphere + cylinder, decay), velocity, grip, head) = hand_decay - the visitor's own movement is the source that wears the surfaces

entropy_jar.expr: sort(step(hand(association(cylinder, glass) + marble * 40 + marble * 40), physics), colour by height band) = entropy_jar - shaking changes local shares; the whole-jar share stays 40/40

entropy_meter.expr: sort(random(array(tile, 200), 10 symbols), by symbol) + array(box, 10, counts) = entropy_meter - a reading of symbol shares; the order of the record does not enter it

jar_states.expr: random(array(association(cylinder, glass) + marble * 40 + marble * 40, 4, starts: sorted, stirred, mixed, shelled), bounded walk) = jar_states - four beginnings under one continuing mixing

order_to_cloud.expr: random(array(grab_sphere, 10 x 10 x 40), jitter rising along z) = order_to_cloud - a lattice walked from grid into cloud

prefab_disorder.expr: hand(assemblage(box, monitor, stool, microscope) + random(the same assemblage, graft parts), slider) = prefab_disorder - the same fifty parts as originals, scattered, and seeded hybrids

two_compartments.expr: random(array(sphere, 8, A) + array(sphere, 8, B) + divider, pair swap) = two_compartments - the colour shares never change; the count of arrangements does

four_cube_sort.expr: sort(hand(pick_up_cube * 2 pink + pick_up_cube * 2 black + divider), colour into boxes) = four_cube_sort - four cubes, sorted by hand: how many ways fit each partition

same_values_shuffled.expr: sort(array(cell, 4 x 4)) + random(array(cell, 4 x 4), shuffle) = same_values_shuffled - the same values with different neighbours

random_removal.expr: random(decide(array(box, 8), eligible: range, row, column, all), remove without replacement) = random_removal - eligibility is decided before the draw; what is gone cannot be drawn again

with_without_replacement.expr: hand(random(array(box, 8), returned) + random(array(box, 8), removed), lever) = with_without_replacement - a draw changes its future only if the member leaves the set

chance_passage_film.expr: exhibit(random(array(slab, 4), angles 45/135)) = chance_passage_film - a screen films sixteen coin decisions becoming walls

pickup_scatter.expr: random(pick_up_cube * 10, place: random, grid, circle, line) = pickup_scatter - where the cubes land shows what the placement rule honours

dealt_diagonals.expr: array(random(array(line, 10), deal exactly k turned), 4, k = 1, 5, 30, 50) = dealt_diagonals - a count dealt, not a chance rolled: at which count order stops reading as order

ten_print_ant_maze.expr: trail(drive(ten_print, turn one wall every 0.08 s), ant search) = ten_print_ant_maze - a maze nobody designed, changing while something looks for a way through

ten_print_cloth.expr: association(ten_print, cloth) * 3 (diagonals, stitches, pixels) + dress = ten_print_cloth - the same 252 draws read as three fabrics, then worn

critter_grid.expr: rule(random(array(critter, 4 x 4 x 4 kingdoms), dna), select, cross, mutate) = critter_grid - drawn DNA under selection: kingdoms as regions of one morphospace

pinned_random_profile.expr: random(array(point, 5), heights, ends held) = pinned_random_profile - a random shape is what was refused as much as what was drawn

continuing_die.expr: decide(thrown_die + array(box, 5, faces), six -> throw again) = continuing_die - the rule, not the die, continues

die_throw.expr: thrown_die + array(box, 6, counts) + step(ball * 96, physics) = die_throw - a physical throw, a record of faces, and a reward in proportion

paired_dice_sum.expr: decide(thrown_die * 2, sum) + array(box, 12, sums) = paired_dice_sum - two read faces become one height; the same height returns by another pair

random_replacement.expr: random(step(cube * 20, physics), arrival clock and victim) = random_replacement - at capacity every arrival needs a removal

coin_toss.expr: step(association(cylinder + grabbable, coin) * 8, physics) + array(box, 2, counts) = coin_toss - one binary outcome, read from which face is up

slope_gradient_cubes.expr: drive(array(cube, 10 x 30, turn rising along z), sway) = slope_gradient_cubes - a graded tilt across a counted floor (no draw in it)

decay_stacks.expr: random(array(box, 5 x 4), accumulate, rate a) + random(array(prism, 12 x 10), accumulate, rate b) = decay_stacks - small draws that add up: two stacks drift, turn and sink at different rates

random_rotation_field.expr: random(field(array(box, 8 x 3 x 8), visitation: even, bell, weather), turn one) = random_rotation_field - a field of chances decides which cube is turned next

pyramid_drop.expr: step(random(array(pyramid, 5), tilt), physics) = pyramid_drop - twenty-five inverted pyramids, each with a small drawn tilt, released at once

leashed_walk.expr: trail(random(step(connect(post + grab_sphere, rope), physics), impulse every 0.3 s)) = leashed_walk - drawn tugs on a tethered body, felt in the hand

position_vs_step.expr: hand(random(rail + carriage, new position) + random(rail + carriage, step from the last) + grab_sphere, lever) = position_vs_step - a new position discards the old one; a step needs somewhere to start

walk_terrarium.expr: random_step_walk * 5 + association(box, glass) = walk_terrarium - five walks in a reflecting tank, each with a 200-position tail

hand_plus_walk.expr: hand(random_step_walk) = hand_plus_walk - the drawing hand and a bounded walk added: the mark is both

walk_laws_rack.expr: association(random_step_walk + grabbable, paper) * 6, six step laws = walk_laws_rack - six sheets, six laws: random was never one thing

constructive_walk.expr: connect(random_step_walk, rod per accepted step) = constructive_walk - a walk that builds: every legal step leaves a point and a rod

pixel_cloud.expr: decide(random(cube * 23, step weighted upward), never revisit) = pixel_cloud - a walk that refuses its own past, kept as cubes

walk_height_field.expr: field(random_step_walk + array(box, 32), height = visits) = walk_height_field - the walk has no memory; the ground it walked on does

law_columns.expr: sampled_histogram × 3 (three laws, one sample count) = law_columns — the same number of draws under three laws: shape is what tells them apart

falling_histogram.expr: step(sample(point, law)) + sort(array(box, 30)) + line(pdf) = falling_histogram — each draw falls into its bin beside the curve it is supposed to follow

gauss_splatter.expr: trail(decide(sample(point, gauss), outside the safe zone)) on quad = gauss_splatter — a bell curve painted dot by dot, with the draws near the centre refused

galton.expr: array(peg, 8 rows) + step(ball × 50, physics) + sort(array(box, 9)) = galton — left-or-right at every peg, a bell curve in the bins

arrivals.expr: step(sample(array(figure, 6), without replacement), random wait) = arrivals — six places filled one at a time: each draw removes what it drew

three_seeds_one_recipe.expr: times(config(figure, seed), 3) = three_seeds_one_recipe — one generator, three seeds side by side: what differs is only the draw

mushroom_field.expr: decide(sample(array(mushroom, 100)), by noise) + ring(mushroom) + cluster(mushroom) on field(noise ground) = mushroom_field — candidates thrown, kept where the noise allows; rings and clusters are written by rule

bubble_rise.expr: step(sample(array(sphere, 200), place, size, drift), rise + fade) in a dish = bubble_rise — a rate of random births, each rising and vanishing

curl_flow.expr: trail(step(array(point, 300), curl(noise))) = curl_flow — particles carried by a field made from noise that can neither gather nor spread

throw_beside_field.expr: random(array(box, 16×16)) beside noise(array(box, 16×16)) = throw_beside_field — independent draws against values that agree with their neighbours

kitbash.expr: connect(sample(array(module, 30), place)) = kitbash — thirty assembled modules thrown into space and tied by pipes, beams and bridges

build.ties: pipes, beams, bridges between random pairs

random_transforms.expr: random(transform(box, sphere, cylinder, cone)) + four sampled rows + noise(array(box, 8×8)) = random_transforms — the same solids, each beside a copy that was turned, scaled and moved by draws

noise_sculpt.expr: noise(assemblage(block, fluid mass, fabric, sphere, drips, bubbles)) = noise_sculpt — a composition whose placements and deformations are read off one noise seed

plan_to_room.expr: array(box, 8×8) plan + rule(random(array(cube, 8×8), height), passage kept open) = plan_to_room — one seeded array read twice: as a plan on the wall and as the room you walk

order_to_chance_net.expr: connect(decide(array(point, 7×13×3), regular net | draw > prob, by position)) = order_to_chance_net — one net from a rule you can predict to a rule you can only describe

of.rule: with probability t(position) a draw decides the pipe, else the regular net

build.ties: pipes up and to eight next-level neighbours

drip_painting.expr: trail(step(sample(stroke: place, colour, width))) on quad + cursor = drip_painting — a random stroke generator leaves its marks; the painting only accumulates

dart_estimate.expr: decide(sample(array(point, 500)), inside the circle) on quad = dart_estimate — count what falls inside: an area, and pi, from draws

pipe_walk.expr: trail(decide(sample(direction of 6), no reversal, prefer straight), cylinder × 180) = pipe_walk — a walk in three dimensions that keeps its body

of.rule: no immediate reversal, prefer straight, stay in bounds

five_kinds_of_chance.expr: array(sphere, 100) under random | noise | rule | flock | sort = five_kinds_of_chance — the same hundred particles moved by five different meanings of random

parts.fn: spiral: angle by index, radius by draw

pheromone_relief.expr: field(height = accumulated mark, pheromone_mark with 5 walkers) = pheromone_relief — the marks pile up into ground: a ridge is where walkers kept agreeing

worley_cells.expr: field(F2 − F1, distance to sample(array(point, 30))) on quad = worley_cells — thrown points divide the plane: the pattern is who is nearest

white_noise_ground.expr: step(random(heightfield, law)) + collider = white_noise_ground — a floor with one independent draw per vertex, redrawn as you stand on it

octave_sum.expr: field(sum(field(sine layer) × 4, persistence, lacunarity)) on quad = octave_sum — one broad layer plus weaker, finer ones: detail is addition

biased_walk_tube.expr: extension(decide(sample(step × 6, 5 tries), nearer the goal), tube) + connect(steps, middle point) = biased_walk_tube — a walk that wanders but arrives, given a body and held to a centre

of.rule: keep a move that ends nearer the goal

one_safe_door.expr: decide(hand, random(door × 3, one passage)) = one_safe_door — the draw is made before you choose; you learn it with your body

of.pick: one of three is the passage

draw_choose_reveal.expr: times(config(decide(hand, random(lane × 2, which is short)), order of draw/choose/reveal), 3) = draw_choose_reveal — the same draw and the same choice in three orders: when did the door decide?

of.axis: schedule: shown first | drawn after | hidden first

random_wait_cube.expr: step(random(cube, wait), fixed cycle of states) = random_wait_cube — you know what it will do next, never when

build.states: idle, going out, hidden, coming back

timed_emitter.expr: physics(step(random(array(cube, 20), start, velocity, jitter), every interval)) = timed_emitter — a clock that keeps throwing: the source is fixed, each throw is drawn

waiting_and_profile.expr: step(pick_up_cube × 2, random wait) + array(random(array(point, 17), height), 5 in depth) = waiting_and_profile — chance in time beside chance in space: a wait you cannot predict, a ridge you can look across

parts.motion: arrive in one of two places

clipped_point.expr: rule(hand(random(grab_sphere, x y)), clamp to bounds) = clipped_point — one draw you can carry, and the bounds that keep correcting it

spacing_bench.expr: random(array(point, 30)) beside min_distance_sample = spacing_bench — the same stream thrown twice: kept as it falls, or filtered by distance

spectral_bars.expr: times(random(array(box, 200), around a power law), 5 colours) = spectral_bars — noise told apart by what it weighs at each frequency: brown, pink, white, blue, violet

white_noise_bars.expr: random(array(box, 50×50), height) = white_noise_bars — 2,500 heights, each drawn alone: no neighbour says anything about the next

uncertain_surface.expr: surface beside hand(random(surface, gauss per vertex), strength) = uncertain_surface — the same connections with moved points: how much noise before it is another surface?

related_signals.expr: random(array(slit, 8)) | step(accumulate) | drive(pink filter), one stream of draws = related_signals — the same draws three times: fresh, summed, filtered; relation is what the draw is added to

spacing_wall.expr: array(config(min_distance_sample, rule, distance, load, seed), 8) = spacing_wall — eight settings of one generator at a fixed volume: read the parameter off the spacing
